title: What we've been playing - "It is 2014 and a woman on a bus calls me disgusting and a charlatan"
summary: It's nearly December. In fact, it will be next week. How do you feel about that? I'm undecided and I also have cold feet. But enough of that, welcome back to our regular feature where we say a bit about the games we've been playing this week! This week, Bertie has been enjoying Leonida but also rural England in the 17th century; Connor has been being a total scumbag and has also found himself coincidentally imprisoned; Matt keeps having revelations and can't stop discovering new things; and Dom's getting dirty looks. Again. Read more
